第 138 章 三塔齐毁大阵崩溃（第1页）
破晓君王催动着六绝猎杀大阵最后的力量，激光和导弹如同雨点般落下。悟空和哪吒浴血奋战，身上的伤口越来越多，但他们丝毫没有退缩。
“悟空，还有多久？”哪吒一边抵挡着攻击，一边对着悟空喊道。
“快了！庄周大人说，还有三分钟，就是下一次0.1秒间隙！”悟空说道，一棍砸爆了一枚飞来的导弹。
“三分钟！大家坚持住！”杨戬大喊一声，天眼金光暴涨，一箭射爆了一台激光炮台。
后羿也同时出手，三支破甲箭同时射出，精准命中了三名机甲驾驶员。
张二狗和申公豹已经潜入了最后三座能量塔的底部。
“二狗，准备好了吗？”申公豹问道。
“放心吧，都准备好了。”张二狗拍了拍身上的炸药包，“这次我用了三倍的药量，保证能把这三座能量塔炸上天！”
所有人都屏住了呼吸，等待着那关键的0.1秒。
庄周的声音，通过灵力传音，清晰地传到了每一个人的耳朵里。
就在六大绝杀体系切换的瞬间，0.1秒的真空间隙再次出现！
悟空怒吼一声，将全身所有的灵力都注入金箍棒，朝着北方能量塔狠狠砸去！
金箍棒带着万钧之力，狠狠砸在能量塔上。巨大的能量塔瞬间出现了无数道裂痕。
哪吒也同时发动攻击，逆火暴涨，火尖枪带着毁天灭地的威力，刺向东方能量塔！
火尖枪精准地刺入了能量塔的核心。
后羿拉满射日弓，三支特制的穿云箭同时射出，精准命中了南方能量塔的三个核心节点！
北方、东方、南方三座最后的核心能量塔，同时爆炸！
巨大的火球冲天而起，照亮了整个天空。
六绝猎杀大阵的能量流动，彻底中断！
笼罩在雁门关上空的紫色能量罩，瞬间破碎！
阳光重新洒落在大地上，温暖而耀眼。
“大阵破了！六绝猎杀大阵被我们打破了！”
所有人都欢呼起来，激动地拥抱在一起。
幸存的士兵们，也纷纷扔掉手中的武器，喜极而泣。
三天三夜的绝望和挣扎，终于换来了胜利。
鹰国的军队彻底乱了。六绝猎杀大阵被破，他们失去了最大的依仗。士兵们惊慌失措，纷纷丢盔弃甲，狼狈地朝着后方逃去。
“不许跑！都给我回来！”破晓君王愤怒地咆哮着，但根本没有人听他的。
看着溃败的军队，看着爆炸的能量塔，破晓君王的脸色变得无比狰狞。
“你们毁了我的六绝猎杀大阵，我要让你们所有人，血债血偿！”

Chapter 138 The three towers were destroyed and the formation collapsed (page 1)
The King of Dawn activated the last power of the Six Ultimate Hunting Formation, and lasers and missiles fell like raindrops. Wukong and Nezha fought bloody battles, with more and more wounds on their bodies, but they did not flinch at all.
"Wukong, how much longer?" Nezha shouted to Wukong while resisting the attack.
"Almost! Lord Zhuang Zhou said, there are still three minutes, the next 0.1 second gap!" Wukong said, smashing a flying missile with one stick.
"Three minutes! Hold on, everyone!" Yang Jian shouted, the golden light of his sky eye surged, and he shot a laser turret with one arrow.
Hou Yi also took action at the same time, shooting three armor-piercing arrows at the same time, accurately hitting the three mecha pilots.
Zhang Ergou and Shen Gongbao have sneaked into the bottom of the last three energy towers.
"Er Gou, are you ready?" Shen Gongbao asked.
"Don't worry, everything is ready." Zhang Ergou patted the explosive pack on his body, "I used three times the amount of explosives this time, and I guarantee that I can blow up these three energy towers into the sky!"
Everyone held their breath, waiting for that critical 0.1 second.
Zhuang Zhou's voice clearly reached everyone's ears through spiritual sound transmission.
At the moment when the six major killing systems were switched, a vacuum gap of 0.1 seconds appeared again!
Wukong roared angrily, poured all the spiritual power in his body into the golden cudgel, and smashed it towards the Northern Energy Tower!
The golden cudgel hit the energy tower with great force. Countless cracks appeared in the huge energy tower instantly.
Nezha also launched an attack at the same time, the backfire surged, and the fire-tip spear stabbed the Eastern Energy Tower with the power to destroy the world!
The fire-tip spear accurately penetrated the core of the energy tower.
Hou Yi fully drew his sun bow and shot three specially made cloud-penetrating arrows at the same time, accurately hitting the three core nodes of the Southern Energy Tower!
The three final core energy towers in the north, east, and south exploded at the same time!
A huge fireball shot into the sky, lighting up the entire sky.
The energy flow of the Six Ultimate Hunting Formation was completely interrupted!
The purple energy shield that shrouded Yanmen Gate shattered instantly!
The sun shines on the earth again, warm and dazzling.
"The formation has been broken! The Six Ultimate Hunting Formation has been broken by us!"
Everyone cheered and hugged each other excitedly.
The surviving soldiers also threw away their weapons and cried with joy.
Three days and nights of despair and struggle finally led to victory.
The Eagle Kingdom's army was in complete chaos. The Six Ultimate Hunting Formation was broken, and they lost their greatest support. The soldiers panicked, abandoned their helmets and armor, and fled toward the rear in embarrassment.
"Don't run away! Come back here!" King Dawn roared angrily, but no one listened to him.
Looking at the defeated army and the exploding energy tower, King Dawn's expression became extremely ferocious.
"You destroyed my Six Ultimate Hunting Formation, and I will make all of you pay for it with blood!"
